description: Submit an audio file URL for speech-to-text transcription. Returns a transcript_id to check status and retrieve results. Supports MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC, OGG, WebM. 99 languages auto-detected. Optional speaker diarization (AssemblyAI)

audio_url.description: Publicly accessible URL of the audio file to transcribe (MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC, OGG, WebM)

model.description: Speech model: "universal-2" (default, fast, 99 languages) or "universal-3-pro" (highest accuracy, promptable)

speaker_labels.description: Enable speaker diarization — detect who said what (default false)

name: audio.transcribe.submit

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Submit Audio for Transcription
